# Voxel Playground

Voxel Playground is a fully destructible VR physics sandbox. Walls, weapons, vehicles, and enemies are micro-voxels.

## Official links

- Website: https://voxelplayground.com/
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4350620/Voxel_Playground/
- Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/voxel-playground/9926748747373800/
- Modding docs: https://voxelplayground.com/doc/documents/manual.html
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/CrYCjTudCH
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Voxel_Playground
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@voxel_playground

## What players do

Grab and smash the world by hand in VR. Scenarios include a bank heist, a prison fight, a survival base against zombie waves, and a sandbox for spawning physics objects. The game also has a modding toolkit.

## Notes

Do not invent a release date. Do not describe Voxel Playground as an official version of another game.
